name: smoothened, frizzled class receptor
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: SMO encodes protein smoothened. Annotated molecular activities include protein sequestering activity and G protein-coupled receptor activity. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Curry-Jones syndrome (autosomal dominant); congenital hypothalamic hamartoma syndrome (autosomal recessive). Postzygotic mosaic associations are recorded separately.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Medulloblastoma; Basal cell carcinoma of skin. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
